# Alchemy Works

> Clothing, home, jewelry and vintage from four California stores. Founded in 2013 in the Arts District of Los Angeles by Raan and Lindsay Parton.

## Stores

- [Signal](https://new.alchemyworks.us/stores/signal/): 821 Traction Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90013. Daily 11am to 7pm. store@alchemyworks.us.
- [Harbor House](https://new.alchemyworks.us/stores/harbor-house/): 3408 Via Oporto, Newport Beach, CA 92663. Sunday to Wednesday 10am to 6pm; Thursday to Saturday 10am to 7pm. 949.438.1183. store@alchemyworks.us.
- [Yountville](https://new.alchemyworks.us/stores/yountville/): 6540 Washington St, Yountville, CA 94599. Monday to Thursday 11am to 5pm; Friday and Saturday 10am to 6pm; Sunday 10am to 5pm. 707.912.7636. napashop@alchemyworks.us.
- [Sea Shop](https://new.alchemyworks.us/stores/sea-shop/): Ocean Ave 2SE at Monte Verde, Carmel by the Sea, CA 93921. Daily 10am to 5pm. 831.760.9950. carmelshop@alchemyworks.us.

## Shopping

- [Shop](https://new.alchemyworks.us/shop/): everything in stock across the four stores.
- [Brands](https://new.alchemyworks.us/brands/)
- [Questions](https://new.alchemyworks.us/faq/): returns, pick up in store, shipping, hours, gift cards.
- [Shipping](https://new.alchemyworks.us/policies/shipping/)
- [Returns and refunds](https://new.alchemyworks.us/policies/returns/)
- [Privacy policy](https://new.alchemyworks.us/policies/privacy/)
- [Terms of service](https://new.alchemyworks.us/policies/terms/)

## Quick facts

- Returns: 10 days from delivery. Vintage, swim, sale and gift cards are final. Fine jewelry is exchange only.
- Shipping: free in the US over $100, otherwise $10. Ships within 3 business days, arrives in 5 to 8.
- Pick up in store: at all four stores, two hours after ordering, for pieces in stock there.
- Gift cards: digital or printed, good online and in all four stores.
- Customer service: store@alchemyworks.us, 10am to 5pm Pacific.
